action_items: SEED/SPEC MISMATCH (non-blocking): Task spec expected BK-2526-0002 agreement to show ₹71,00,000 with Indian grouping; current seed renders ₹65,00,000 (flat value) + ₹2.7L other = ₹69.6L total agreement. Indian-grouping formatting itself is correct (verified via multiple amounts). Main agent should decide whether to (a) update seed data to match the spec amount, or (b) update the task-spec assertion to match the current seed.
critical_code_review_comments: infra.py surfaces_enabled(request) correctly returns False when PUBLIC_SURFACES_ENABLED=false AND the request does not carry the LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_BYPASS_TOKEN header; middleware then short-circuits /api/public/* and /api/portal/* to a 404 envelope with code=NOT_FOUND and request_id. Clean design.

backend/tests/conftest.py (lines 31-38 and 70-74) auto-injects X-Rate-Limit-Bypass on all requests/httpx calls. Any new 'parked surfaces' test MUST avoid these libraries (use urllib directly) or the bypass re-enables the surfaces and the 404 assertion will fail. Consider adding a conftest fixture `raw_client` or an opt-out marker (e.g., @pytest.mark.no_bypass) to make this ergonomic for future tests.

Post Payment sheet UX: after submit, the sheet remains open on 'POSTED' state and the user must manually click 'Print / download receipt' which opens the /print/receipt/{id} page in a NEW TAB (window.open). The task spec reads 'receipt print page opens at /print/receipt/<paymentId>' which is satisfied, but automated e2e tests should expect a popup rather than same-tab navigation.

Receipt print page uses <embed>/<iframe> for the PDF so page.inner_text('body') cannot verify the KKT letterhead text from the UI alone; this is correctly covered by the backend PDF-text test. Keeping both tests is the right defense-in-depth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 7 flow steps verified; one seed-value mismatch noted as non-blocking)

seed_data_creation: Posted 2 small test payments on BK-2526-0002 (₹1,000 Cash each, receipts KKT/2627/00008 and KKT/2627/00009) during manual flow verification. Does not meaningfully perturb the test seed; cash paid rose from ₹10,00,000 -> ₹10,02,000.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To test the parked public/portal surfaces, DO NOT use the shared `requests` session that conftest.py monkeypatches - it adds X-Rate-Limit-Bypass automatically and that header is the test switch that re-enables surfaces. Use urllib.request (or a fresh requests.Session with explicit header={}, which still gets patched - urllib is safer). The Post Payment flow opens the receipt in a popup (window.open) not same-tab, so use page.expect_popup() when automating. Current BK-2526-0002 id in the seed is faf6ae4b-13cc-4672-9754-e9f43c9d07e0 and agreement_value is ₹65,00,000 flat + ₹2.7L other (total ₹69.6L); if spec says ₹71,00,000 either reseed or relax the assertion. Receipt prefix is KKT; latest receipt numbers after this run: KKT/2627/00009. All screenshots saved under /app/memory/qa/refocus/ (02..07).
rca of the issue: No functional issue found. Original test harness friction: initial 3 pytest failures (public_projects_parked, portal_config_parked, bootstrap surfaces) were an artefact of /app/backend/tests/conftest.py auto-injecting X-Rate-Limit-Bypass on all requests.*. Mitigation applied: new test file uses urllib.request for the parked-surface and bootstrap checks so the bypass is never attached. After mitigation, 7/7 pass. Phase C requirements (ERP-only, no /erp prefix, no customer_portal UI, ₹ Indian grouping, KKT branding on login + sidebar + receipt PDF, CSV without paise, health <500ms) are all met in both backend and frontend.
